title: Internal render API contract (v0)
description: Contract between apps/api (Go) and apps/renderer (Node). POST /internal/render. The renderer is a pure function: (design, data, options) -> SVG. It is never exposed publicly.

data.description: Merged connector snapshots keyed by connector name, e.g. {"github": {...}}. Template paths in the design resolve against this object. Already filtered to bound fields by the API — the renderer never sees credentials or unbound data.

svg.description: Self-contained, sanitized, Camo-safe SVG. Deterministic for identical input.

warnings.description: Non-fatal issues, e.g. unresolved template paths.
